scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Infinitely many pairwise-coprime three-term Achilles arithmetic progressions, and the least largest term for primitive three-term Achilles progressions is 57967.
limitations: No classification of all primitive triples or of four-term Achilles progressions
No bound on common difference relative to first term
Finite enumeration proves only optimal first occurrence; infinity has a symbolic argument
No independent mathematical audit or priority certification
proof_dependencies: integral Sylvester resultant identity and its factorization
complete enumeration of all Achilles numbers at most 57967

title: Primitive Achilles progressions: an infinite family and a sharp first occurrence
